curationLog: Rows curated 2026-08-30 by three research agents (docs/RESEARCH/benchmark-curation-2026-08-30.md): US and UK from official statistics (BLS OEWS public API, ONS ASHE 2025 provisional), GCC from GulfTalent public salary pages, India from Instahyre public reports, Singapore from Morgan McKinley 2026 public tables, Germany from Stepstone Gehalt pages.

Conflict rule: when two sources cover the same cell, the higher-quality row wins and the alternative is recorded in the row note. ARE it-executive executive: the enterprise recruiter-band row (Medium) was kept over the GulfTalent CTO page (n=15, Low); the GulfTalent figures are noted on the row.
Countries use ISO3 codes; UK rows are recorded as GBR.

Egypt and Indonesia have zero benchmark rows after every allowed free source failed verification (gated guides, dead tools, entry-level-only data). Their cells stay insufficient-data markers rather than shipping unverifiable numbers.

Second Asia/EU pass (duplicate agent) added 18 cells the first pass missed: Singapore non-tech sectors, Egypt tech bands (egytech.fyi 2025 community survey, 1,413 responses, EGP 2025 data with currency caveat), and German lead titles. Overlapping cells kept the first-pass rows per the conflict rule (SGP it-executive executive stays as Head of Infrastructure rather than the CISO mapping).
